headlines.title: Meta announces $95 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
headlines.summary: Listen up — a $95 billion equity raise is the kind of tape-moving event that rattles the whole neighborhood. META itself gets hit with dilution, but the real story is Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom potentially taking shares, which ties the chip sector directly into this deal and signals where the smart money thinks AI capex is heading. This is peak earnings week and the Street is already skittish on AI valuations — this one lands like a bowling ball in a quiet pond.

headlines.title: Brazil Markets Suffer Rout After Lula's Improbable Election Win
headlines.summary: Lula pulling off a comeback nobody priced in is a genuine shock to EM positioning — Brazilian dollar bonds are already getting hit in London and the real is under pressure, which ripples into soybeans, coffee, sugar, and any fund with EM exposure. Bolsonaro refusing to concede adds a political risk premium that keeps the bid thin on Brazilian assets for days. Watch EWZ and the commodity complex for the spillover.

headlines.title: Anthropic Is Said to Plan Public Filing for Mega-IPO Monday
headlines.summary: Anthropic dropping its S-1 on a Monday morning during peak earnings week and a Fed meeting is the kind of event that reshuffles capital across the entire AI sector — money comes out of existing AI names to fund the new issue. This is a potentially record-breaking debut that will set the valuation benchmark for every private AI company on the Street's radar. The timing alone makes it a volatility catalyst for NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, and anything else wearing an AI badge.
